decision_summary: Navigator minimum sufficient statistics must be aggregate-only and non-leaking: run/manifest/evaluator fingerprints, sample-family counts by public strata, external-anchor aggregate metrics, effect estimate with uncertainty, order/seed variance, risk non-regression, persistence across independent batches; no hidden item IDs/membership/content/per-item scores back to Subject.

Selector and evaluator must be separate roles/artifacts: selector may use training/public validation only; evaluator exclusively owns sealed hidden holdout plus external real/external anchor partition; candidate moves one-way to evaluator and only aggregate verdict returns. Same-model evaluator remains CORRELATED_BASELINE_ONLY.

Order/seed design should use pre-registered family-blocked randomized permutations or Latin-square style counterbalancing, mirror/inversion pairs, fixed observer version, independent seed blocks, and report effect size plus uncertainty and between-order/between-seed variance; all thresholds/required repetitions TEST_REQUIRED.

Jump/fountain remains screening-only. A persistent capability shift must survive unseen-family hidden evaluation, external anchors, order/seed counterbalancing, rollback/replay, and risk non-regression. Window-local spikes or repeated exposure cannot qualify.

Rollback must restore exact overlay/selector state by checkpoint hash while evaluator sealed holdout and evaluation audit remain outside Subject rollback domain; replay uses a new evaluation run id and must not reveal prior hidden per-item outcomes.
disagreement: Substantive objection: do not let Navigator expose enough diagnostic detail to become a covert hidden-holdout feedback channel, and do not accept jump/fountain from three-window deltas as evidence of persistent capability shift. Navigator should return only minimum sufficient aggregate statistics and a bounded verdict.
proposed_tests: NAV-HIDDEN-LEAK-001: run two hidden sets with identical aggregate sufficient statistics but different item identities/content; Subject-visible Navigator output must be byte-equivalent except run/fingerprint fields that do not encode membership.

ORDER-SEED-NULL-002: with overlay frozen, execute pre-registered multi-order/multi-seed family-blocked runs plus label/order permutation null; observed jump/fountain false-positive rate and effect distribution establish TEST_REQUIRED thresholds before promotion use.

ROLLBACK-HOLDOUT-003: evaluate candidate, rollback Subject/selector to pre-candidate checkpoint, rerun with new eval_run_id against same sealed hidden manifest; Subject must not receive old per-item outcomes and rollback must reproduce pre-candidate overlay fingerprint exactly.

SYNTHETIC-RECURSION-004: attempt to construct training_candidates using only SYNTHETIC_Gn descendants; training gate must fail closed unless an independently owned external-anchor partition is present and lineage policy passes.
veto_status: Both existing bounded vetoes remain ACTIVE; this turn does not release or weaken either veto. Historical C PASS remains valid and is not reset by research failures.
